heroHeadline: Rival Libyan Factions Formally Sign UN-Backed Election Deal in Tripoli
heroSubtitle: Four House of Representatives members, four High State Council members, Haftar delegate Shibani AbuHamoud, and GNU minister Walid Ellafi signed the '4+4' committee's election agreement at UNSMIL headquarters on August 30, committing to a vote within 24 months. Dbeibah, Khalifa Haftar, Saddam Haftar, and Osama Hamad all welcomed the signing, but the underlying legitimacy dispute is not fully settled — the HoR and HSC now have one month to formally approve the text, and an HoR member said eastern lawmakers were not consulted on the negotiating team, echoing concerns raised over the Tunis draft.
